annotations.text: The loop: pick a mode and you are flying in seconds, build a kit you own, fight for three minutes, take bounty as rivets, spend it, climb the week.

The one idea underneath all six screens.

Alpha deals every spawn 30 random upgrades today (spawn_prizes = 30). A kit is those same thirty, chosen in the hangar instead of rolled at the pad. Nothing is added to the ship, so the drill's matched-kit harness keeps working.

The pips on this screen actually spend.

There is nothing on the field to pick up: prizes are gone entirely and your kit is the whole ship.

Death re-deals the frame but never the ammunition, so the charge pips in the corner run down across the whole match rather than refilling when you die.
Bounty starts at 1 and rises by one a kill. Whoever ends your run takes it as rivets, so score and currency are one number.
Rivets buy what you may slot, never how much. Everything trades against the same thirty.
Rating is the career ladder and moves slowly. The week is the short one, and resets on Monday.

Nothing pauses, so a menu costs you match time while somebody shoots at you. Anything you cannot act on right now is not in here: hangar, shop and standings live at the front end.

It stays a menu rather than a bare leave button because on a phone this is the only way to reach settings and the controls.
